with three speakers.
K. Let's discuss how we're going to train the new
Web developers who'll join our team next month. They
live in several different countries, so they'll be working
from home. Any ideas?
Hmm... We could set up a conference call for the
training. But some of the new employees live in a different
time zone. It may be difficult to schedule the call.
Why don't we make a video? That way the new
employees can watch the training video whenever it's
most convenient for them.
That's a good idea. Carla-is that something you
could make?
Absolutely! But Ol'd better get started right away-it
will take at least a couple of weeks to complete.
